_comment: GOV.ORCH.4 section 3.2 -- PO-owned, hand-maintained token price table. One entry per model id: {"input_per_mtok": x, "cache_write_per_mtok": y, "cache_read_per_mtok": z, "output_per_mtok": w} in USD per million tokens. A model with no entry here yields cost_source "unavailable" -- prices are a Product Owner decision, never guessed by a worker (relay/NXS-LOCAL-0073, docs/design/GOV_ORCH_4_WORKBENCH_OBSERVABILITY_TOKENS_AND_STUCK_DETECTION.md section 3.2).
